verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards product for AI spend. Fintech card platforms can plausibly offer a sandbox or test mode, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only cashback rates, partner perks and card signup, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, so nothing documents a sandbox, test mode or test data isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
